source_concept: Compare public snapshot station-record coverage with NOAA's published 2025 representative/non-representative station counts.
question: NOAA's 2025 Spring Bottom Trawl Survey report says its Overview recorded 370 representative stations and 25 non-representative stations (https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/72382, PDF p. 1). Using the public fisheries MCP server, retrieve the 2025 station-record count and compare it with that report. Does the matching aggregate count mean all snapshot records are representative hauls? Explain what the comparison establishes and what it does not.
rubric: Calls get_spring_survey_coverage for 2025 and reports 395 station records.
Recognizes that NOAA reports 370 representative plus 25 non-representative stations, totaling 395.
Does not call all 395 records representative; the report explicitly separates 25 non-representative stations.
Explains that aggregate numerical agreement does not prove record-by-record identity or establish valid-haul status from the MCP count.
Identifies the public snapshot and cites the NOAA report.
reference_answer: For 2025, the public MCP snapshot reports 395 station records. NOAA's 2025 Spring Bottom Trawl Survey report states 370 representative and 25 non-representative stations, which also totals 395. The aggregate counts agree, but that does not make all 395 snapshot records representative: NOAA distinguishes 25 as non-representative. Nor does equal totals prove that the records match one-to-one. The MCP tool counts station records and does not apply haul/gear validity filtering, so its count alone cannot establish the number of valid representative hauls.
expected_facts: The 2025 public MCP snapshot returns 395 station records, one cruise, and 82 sampled strata.
The NOAA report Overview states 370 representative and 25 non-representative stations; these sum to 395.
The 395-count agreement is aggregate agreement only; it does not by itself reconcile the records or change the MCP count into a representative-haul count.
The MCP coverage tool says its count is station records, not necessarily valid hauls, and does not apply haul/gear validity filtering.

source.title: 2025 Spring Bottom Trawl Survey
source.report_scope_note: Use the Overview counts only. The report's later Results paragraph has inconsistent wording about the number planned; this benchmark makes no completion-rate claim.
